title: ticfac sandbox worker-prompt accepts schema-invalid and path-escaping tick records that tk refused
description:
readSandboxTick (internal/cli/sandbox.go:697-711) only JSON-decodes the record. A tick {"id":"a1w","title":"t"} renders a prompt where tk exited 1 because status is required. `--tick ../evil` reads .tick/evil.json and renders branch tick//evil. The code's own comment says booting a worker on damaged state is worse than not booting. Validate the id as a tick id, and the record's required fields, as tk did.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding 83fcb9a55a986df383767279dafb875d4170e0a23072e4f1fc31b15a0882208c (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-tdu/attempt-7): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/83fcb9a55a986df383767279dafb875d4170e0a23072e4f1fc31b15a0882208c.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-09-28 12:16 - ticfac run epic-6in: created by absorbing finding 83fcb9a55a986df383767279dafb875d4170e0a23072e4f1fc31b15a0882208c — a backlog tick: the done is reachable with the finding standing. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/83fcb9a55a986df383767279dafb875d4170e0a23072e4f1fc31b15a0882208c.json on epic/6in, and it says: the epic's acceptance is prose (the acceptance carries no [A<n>]-marked items, so its definition of done is prose: nothing is runnable, nothing can be pointed at, and whether a finding gates it cannot be decided — refusing to absorb rather than guessing. Mark the acceptance into stable [A<n>] items first (ticks goal-design.md, fact sheets), then decide absorption against them.), so there is no item the reporter's claim could gate and no judgement for a person to make: the finding is backlog work, filed as a tick with an owner. The reporter does not claim it breaks the build or CI, the one claim that gates a prose done
